scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w clarklab-api" "npm run dev -w clarklab-frontend"
scripts.dev:stack: docker compose up -d postgres && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w clarklab-api && npm run build -w clarklab-frontend
scripts.reinstall: rm -rf node_modules clarklab-api/node_modules clarklab-frontend/node_modules clarklab-frontend/node_modules/.vite package-lock.json && npm install
